categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) in various villages, making it primarily concerned with land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
